domain.public_dtype: Matching BF16 or FP32 q/k/v/do; dq/dk/dv match input; all other public data FP32. Canonical unit selects BF16.

workspace.tape: FP32 64-state per-value-head replay tape; last first-chunk contents returned for stage validation
workspace.ownership: unique perB/HV recurrence; deterministic final perB/T/H sum

saved_state.training: Standalone explicit first derivative; no autograd connection and no dh0
saved_state.precision: BF16 operands widen in VF; FP32 checkpoint/tape/adjoint and grouped partials; final dq/dk/dv RNE to BF16. No state is exported for another unit.

provenance.formula: Standalone derivative of pinned naive; source derives from unchanged GDA-03, with only BF16 storage boundaries and kernel cotangent initialization.

byte_identity.note: The five public outputs are included among the ten stage arrays; do not add these as distinct arrays.

host_dispatch.scope: Every native public BF16/FP32 grid row; no host data conversion, copy, reordering or arithmetic.

source_emission.scope: All three new entry symbols through accepted Ascriptor CCE compile CLI; full lowering/event balance, distinct from vendor compilation.

vendor_build.scope: Six entry symbols (three original FP32 and three BF16), each block_dim1/2; twelve actual CCE builds.

performance.scope: Complete old FP32/new BF16/old FP32 public backward, including checkpoints; B1/H=HV8/K=V128,T1024/4096,bd2,3rounds,10warmup50repeat, sync before and after every call.

runtime_startup_control.scope: Fresh no-task-kernel control reproduces both vendor startup notice classes, returns exact expected values; no error/fatal/critical in retained runtime logs.

secondary_vendor_build.scope: Supplementary environment only; original FP32 checkpoint fails before any custom kernel execution due to pinned library/vendor header guard mismatch.
